engine: Production compact v64/v155/v158, no score injection, no physical or Unity series
scope: Initial contracted squads only; no youth pool, transfers, preceding matches or carried development
selection: Fixed club groups by mean initial squad quality across the same thirty worlds. League-cup uses the TEN STRONGEST cup-only clubs, a closest-gap stress comparison. Large ranks 3/4 and AUT/SUI/TUR ranks 1/2 use country ranking by the same mean.
design: Five original measurement seeds; independent full JSON world copy per game; native AI tactics, lineups, substitutions and in-match fatigue. Reference series: ten unordered pairings per world, each played in both orientations; cycles cover all forty-five unordered pairings. League-cup and overlap: all cross-pairs once per seed. Home: ten mixed-strength pairs per seed in both orientations; neutral twin keeps seed, fixture ID, side assignment and roster unchanged, varying only fixture.neutral.
checks: 1200 complete native compact games plus five exact replays
unchanged production controllers and source hashes
all initial rosters reproduce measurement budgets
full initial freshness and independent JSON copy per game
native AI, roles, load, shots and match ratings
goal totals, on-target shots and match record reconcile
league-cup and overlap: every pair five times with balanced home status
100 mirrored games and 100 paired neutral controls
